local_review.author: GOAT Anatomy

direct_observations.observation: Character close-ups give way to a wide full-body rink view, preserving both skaters and movement space.
Podium/ceremony and archival rink/ceremony shots continue the public-success setup; lower-third Chinese with smaller English remains visible on multiple sampled frames.
A black intertitle reads 可命运偏偏最见不得圆满; sampled frames show a preceding blur and a change from white to dark red/blue-edged text. Exact animation and audio synchronization remain unverified.
Female and male portrait close-ups are connected with RGB-split/glitch-like color separation and fades; this is a visual effect description, not a claim about the plugin or sound.

The story returns to full-body archival skating while a lower-third begins a dated fact about 1995 and the male skater's death, placing the factual event after the contrast intertitle rather than in the first seconds.

local_review.interpretation: The first 30 seconds move from athletic action and partnership success to an explicit reversal card, then portraits and a dated event. This supports a story-level setup-to-reversal sequence, but one author/sample cannot justify a production rule.
local_review.counterexample: Do not use the black emotional intertitle or RGB-split portrait effect in match tactics or interview translation; it would interrupt action evidence and can overdramatize sensitive facts.
